gallery.title: File:Kennywood Thunderbolt DSCN2744.JPG
gallery.description:
A scene from Kennywood, an amusement park located in West Mifflin, Pennsylvania on the Monongahela River.
This is a view of the historic Thunderbolt ride. This Roller coaster ride dates to 1924. It started out as the Pippin but was reprofiled and expanded in 1967. It still uses 1958 vintage Century Flyer trains.

In this view a train is descending the initial drop after the first lift hill.
categories: Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation

gallery.title: File:Phantom's Revenge second drop.jpg
gallery.description:
A scene from Kennywood, an amusement park located in West Mifflin, Pennsylvania on the Monongahela River.

This is a view from the station of the Phantom's Revenge looking toward the Monongahela River. A steep midtrack drop of the Phantom' s Revenge is visible, going down the cliff into the ravine. The first major drop of the track of the Thunderbolt is visible, showing clearly how the terrain is used, and how the tracks intertwine. A train of the Thunderbolt is ascending, just about to engage the first lift hill.
